d:
Sonia Gandhi ki kitab men Nitish Kumar ko lekar likhi gaee baton ne bihar ki rajniti men naya vivad khara kar diya hai. sanjay jha ke davon se ashamti jatate hue manoj jha ne INDIA gathbandhan ki baithkon ke nots sarvajnik karne ka ailan kiya hai. saval hai ki in nots se kiski bat majbut hogi aur bihar ki maujuda siyasat par iska kya asar par sakta hai?
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
